headline: Comment on reports that the head of "Turonbank" bank has been detained
summary: Turonbank said it continues to operate normally and that its obligations to customers remain in force. Reports said the bank's board chairman, Chori Mirzayev, was detained on suspicion of large-scale embezzlement, which the bank neither confirmed nor denied.
why: Turonbank is an Uzbek commercial bank, and governance problems at lenders can affect depositor confidence and the local banking sector.
original_headline: “Turonbank” bank rahbari qo‘lga olingani haqidagi xabarlarga izoh berdi
